description.en: Manage the MCP servers of this Harness from Settings: global (home-layer) and workspace (profile-layer) servers, add, edit, enable/disable, delete, test connectivity, import/export JSON, and reuse one configuration across workspaces from a machine-wide server library.
description.zh: 在设置页管理 Harness 的 MCP 服务器：全局（home 层）与工作区（profile 层）两层，支持新增、编辑、启用/停用、删除、连通性测试、JSON 导入导出，并可从全机共享的服务器库把同一份配置复用到其他工作区。
